rows.note: A contest on the settlement's board in Each mode; its condition and prize come from a liveops.contests row (GDD 14.3). Provisional.
A staged storm: a shortage the settlement answers for staged prizes, never coin. Provisional.
A staged scare: a panic the settlement answers for staged prizes. Provisional.
A staged drill: a raid the settlement answers for staged prizes. Provisional.
A small drop of crates on one tile (GDD 14.4). Provisional.
A tier 2 hunt of a world hunt's creature. Provisional.
A fair: every fair contest and a small drop for one world day. Provisional.
A tier 3 hunt of a world hunt's creature. Provisional.
A large drop of crates on one tile (GDD 14.4). Provisional.
A competing vault: one fork machine two parties race for; the first solve takes the haul. Priced as a small drop. Provisional.
An admin's pattern: the triangle laid by its shape around a tile, with no chain; its solve pays a staged cache. Admins only.
